parsed.name: 事件序列器
parsed.description: 事件序列器是一种实验时序控制设备，用于按预设顺序输出事件码或触发事件，以协调束线、探测器、电机或其他实验站设备的同步动作。它常用于加速器与同步辐射/自由电子激光实验中，实现扫描期间或采集过程中的精确定时控制。
parsed.description_en: An event sequencer is a timing control instrument that outputs programmed event codes or trigger events in a defined order to coordinate synchronized actions among beamline equipment, detectors, motors, or other experimental devices. It is commonly used in accelerator and photon-science experiments for precise timing control during scans and data acquisition.

actions.description: 完成当前事件序列运行并等待序列结束。
actions.description_en: Complete the current event sequence run and wait for the sequence to finish.

actions.description: 启动事件序列器并开始监测其运行状态。
actions.description_en: Start the event sequencer and begin monitoring its running state.

actions.description: 暂停当前事件序列运行。
actions.description_en: Pause the current event sequence run.

actions.description: 恢复已暂停的事件序列运行。
actions.description_en: Resume a paused event sequence run.

actions.description: 触发事件序列器执行一次新的序列运行。
actions.description_en: Trigger the event sequencer to execute a new sequence run.

actions.description: 显示当前事件序列内容。
actions.description_en: Show the current event sequence contents.
